verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published overage fee schedule for Workers: no per-invocation, bandwidth, or build-minute overage rates. The only billing-related item says Cloudflare charges for compute rather than wall time, which describes the billing model, not the fees for exceeding plan limits. Community mentions of CPU-time limits cover execution caps, not overage pricing.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
